name: bt_le_start_advertising

ownership.argument: Candidate for the advertising start half of Astrolink's F_ADVERTISING_CREATE pair; the stop half and the scan pair are still open.

provenance.source: Builds the advertising parameters on the stack (type 0x1C, registers the advertising data record once through 0xC701480/0xC2E3994 under byte_20126828), then calls the MiWear GAP advertising start 0xC7D3EB4(name, params, (flags & 2) != 0, (flags & 8) != 0) and reports the result through 0xC70E6F4. Four call sites plus the log tag 'bt_le_start_advertising'.

notes: Candidate for the advertising start half of Astrolink's F_ADVERTISING_CREATE pair; the stop half and the scan pair are still open.
